purpose: Simulated HubSpot CRM records in HubSpot v3 default-property shape. Populates companies (30), contacts (~60), deals (~40), activities (~50). Includes console-enriched custom-property examples (btx_ttm_revenue_cents_console_enriched, btx_last_order_date_console_enriched, btx_customer_segment_console_enriched, btx_program_id_console_enriched) that demonstrate the bidirectional write-back pattern from the audit.

truth_rules.default_v3_properties_only: Standard HubSpot v3 properties every portal has (hs_object_id, name, domain, industry, hubspot_owner_id, lifecyclestage, firstname, lastname, jobtitle, dealname, dealstage, amount, closedate, hs_activity_type). BTX-custom property fidelity is deferred until BTX HubSpot is authorized.
truth_rules.console_enriched_marker: Custom properties prefixed btx_*_console_enriched carry the field-ownership marker per audit section 7d.
truth_rules.bidirectional_pattern: This file is what the console reads (companies, contacts, deals, activities) plus what the console writes (btx_*_console_enriched properties on companies/deals).
truth_rules.no_real_contacts: Contact firstname/lastname are randomized POC placeholders. No email or phone populated. No real HubSpot data. Consult batch 2 btx_researched_contacts.json for real public procurement contacts.
truth_rules.provenance: Every record is synthetic and marked data_mode=SAMPLE, synthetic=true. No real BTX customer commercial data is asserted.

contacts.note: Simulated contact for POC; no personal info populated. Consult SIMULATED_POC_ATTESTATION for real customer contacts.
